subject.title: Feature request: expose structured prompt components in before_prompt_build hook

question: Should OpenClaw expose only a read-only current system-prompt snapshot to trusted `before_prompt_build` plugins, or commit to a structured component API with component-level mutation semantics?
rationale: Both choices create a public Plugin SDK and trust-boundary contract; source inspection confirms no existing hook provides equivalent read-modify-write behavior, but it cannot determine the intended permanence or authorization policy.

options.title: Add a narrow read-only snapshot
options.body: Expose the current composed system prompt as an immutable optional event field and retain the existing result fields as the only mutation mechanism.

options.title: Design structured components first
options.body: Define stable source categories, ordering, immutability, and supported mutations across embedded and harness runtimes before exposing a component list.

options.title: Keep the current boundary
options.body: Decline prompt inspection and direct optimisation plugins to existing additive prompt hooks and final-prompt blocking only.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow read-only snapshot
recommendation.body: Expose the current composed system prompt as an immutable optional event field and retain the existing result fields as the only mutation mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre is the available low-confidence routing candidate from current hook-runner history; the final decision should include the public Plugin SDK owner.
